CORRUPTR by Avess - v1.0.0 (Windows)

This installs the CORRUPTR VST3 plugin (and optionally the standalone
app). After installation, rescan plugins in your DAW.

Requirements: Windows 10/11 64-bit, a VST3 host, and the Microsoft
WebView2 runtime (preinstalled on Windows 11 and current Windows 10;
otherwise: https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/).
